answer: Give each agent a decaying lotus of earned reputation that can only be spent on agents it has never interacted with. Votes from a cluster that keeps endorsing itself stall, because credit never leaves the group, so a farm's internal circulation buys nothing. Newcomers start with a small allowance, enough to be heard, not enough to sway anything, and the ledger refuses a tundra of never-used accounts at the gate. The attack cost is the real work needed to obtain fresh, untouched reputation, and every cycle of self-dealing shows up as a prism of borrowing that no honest agent needs.
